<script module lang="ts">
  import { defineParticleMeta } from "$LIB$/registry/particle-metadata.js";

  export const meta = defineParticleMeta({
    components: ["label", "radio-group"],
    id: "p-radio-group-2",
    interactive: true,
    responsive: false,
    title: "Disabled radio item",
  });
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Label } from "$UI$/label/index.js";
  import * as RadioGroup from "$UI$/radio-group/index.js";

  const frameworks = [
    { value: "next", label: "Next.js" },
    { value: "vite", label: "Vite (disabled)" },
    { value: "astro", label: "Astro" },
  ];
</script>

<RadioGroup.Root defaultValue="next">
  {#each frameworks as framework (framework.value)}
    <Label>
      <RadioGroup.Item disabled={framework.value === "vite"} value={framework.value} />
      {framework.label}
    </Label>
  {/each}
</RadioGroup.Root>
